title: 第11章 勾结第12章 夜色温柔
content_zh:
第11章勾结萧沉突然意识到，刺杀他的人，不止来自周家！
轰！
狂暴气息绽放，萧沉双拳皆出，拳意刚猛，那两道刺来的利剑立时被拳威崩碎，根本封不住萧沉的路！
两人面色骤变，恐怕要苦海境八重之人，才能对抗萧沉的拳头！
这绝对是惊世骇俗的，苦海境五重的修士，竟能拥有这等恐怖的战力！
“就凭你们，也想要杀我？”
萧沉分别扼住了他们的咽喉，他们疯狂挣扎，却无法挣脱。
“我们也是奉命行事。”
两人的脸都憋紫了，喘不上气来。
“奉命？可我若真是废人，此刻已经命丧你们手里。”
萧沉眸中闪烁炽盛杀意，脑海中渐渐回想起他们所使剑法的来历！
咔嚓！
伴随着一声脆响，两人的喉骨都被他捏断，倒在了地上。
萧沉没有问他们幕后黑手是谁，而是将他们的尸体全都丢到了院子门口。
“哥！”
焮儿躲了起来，看到萧沉走进房间，才怯生生地喊道。
“别怕。”
萧沉轻轻拍了拍焮儿的后背，让焮儿逐渐安心下来。
不过，萧沉的眼里也有冰冷之色闪烁，他前面一直和白念冰等人在一起，才刚刚回到院子，这些人就出现了。
这时机，也太巧了！

“萧兄！”
白念冰恰好有事来找萧沉，看到门外摆放的四具尸体，心中顿时一颤。
“你没事吧。”
白念冰上下打量着萧沉，关切地问道。
萧沉淡淡一笑，“我没事，想要我的命，没那么容易。”
“是大长老派的人。”
白念冰先是松了口气，而后眸光凝固起来，其中两具尸体，她认得，正是大长老的亲信！
更让白念冰感到惊讶的是，这两名亲信的实力，都不在她之下，可是，却死在了萧沉手中。
这是否意味着，萧沉，也拥有击败她的实力？
这家伙，到底隐藏了多少？
“另外两个，是周家的人。”
萧沉淡漠开口，白念冰自然知道他说的是谁。
“这件事，我会处理清楚，你跟我来。”
白念冰的神情很认真，也很严肃。
“白家所有长老，齐聚大长老的院落。”
content_en:
Chapter 11 Collusion Xiao Chen suddenly realized that the people who assassinated him were not only from the Zhou family!
boom!
The violent aura bloomed, Xiao Chen punched out with both fists, and the fists were fierce. The two sharp swords were immediately shattered by the power of the fists, unable to block Xiao Chen's path at all!
The expressions of the two people changed suddenly. I am afraid that it would take someone at the eighth level of the Sea of ​​Bitter Realm to resist Xiao Chen's fist!
This is absolutely shocking. A monk at the fifth level of the Sea of ​​Bitter Realm can actually possess such terrifying combat power!
"You alone want to kill me?"
Xiao Chen grabbed their throats respectively. They struggled wildly, but couldn't break free.
"We are also following orders."
Both of their faces were purple from suffocation and they couldn't breathe.
"According to the order? But if I were really a useless person, I would have died in your hands right now."
Xiao Chen's eyes flashed with murderous intent, and his mind gradually recalled the origin of the sword techniques they used!
Click!
With a crisp sound, the throat bones of both of them were crushed by him and they fell to the ground.
Xiao Chen did not ask them who was behind the scenes, but threw all their bodies at the entrance of the yard.
"Brother!"
Yan'er hid and shouted timidly when she saw Xiao Chen walking into the room.
"Don't be afraid."
Xiao Chen gently patted her back, making her gradually feel at ease.
However, there was also a cold flash in Xiao Chen's eyes. He had been with Bai Nianbing and others in front of him, and he had just returned to the yard when these people appeared.
This timing is too coincidental!
"Brother Xiao!"
Bai Nianbing happened to come to Xiao Chen for something. When he saw the four corpses placed outside the door, his heart suddenly trembled.
"Are you okay?"
Bai Nianbing looked Xiao Chen up and down and asked with concern.
Xiao Chen smiled lightly, "I'm fine. It's not that easy to kill me."
"He's from the Great Presbyterian sect."
Bai Nianbing breathed a sigh of relief at first, and then her eyes hardened. She recognized two of the corpses as the great elder's cronies!
What surprised Bai Nianbing even more was that the strength of these two cronies was not inferior to hers, but they died in Xiao Chen's hands.
Does this mean that Xiao Chen also has the strength to defeat her?
How much does this guy hide?
"The other two are from the Zhou family."
Xiao Chen spoke indifferently, and Bai Nianbing naturally knew who he was talking about.
"I will handle this matter clearly, you come with me."
Bai Nianbing's expression was very serious and serious.
"All the elders of the Bai family gathered in the courtyard of the great elder."
